entities.summary: A bairro is a Portuguese word for a quarter or a neighborhood or, sometimes, a district which is within a city or town. It is commonly used in Portugal, Brazil, Mozambique, Guinea-Bissau, and other Portuguese-speaking places. Bairro is cognate with Spanish barrio and Catalan barri, descending from the same Andalusi Arabic word بري or bárri, meaning outskirts or surroundings of a city.
